message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern thrillers, and some hidden gems—perfect for a Friday night scare fest:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A chilling psychological horror set in an isolated hotel. |
| 2 | **Get Out** (2017) | A smart social thriller that blends horror with sharp satire. |
| 3 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn family drama that turns into a nightmare. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that flips the genre on its head. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | An unsettling premise about a curse that stalks you forever. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Silence is survival; tension builds with every footstep. |
| 7 | **The Babadook** (2014) | A psychological horror that feels like a haunting story. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | Paranormal investigators tackle a terrifying case. |
| 9 | **The Witch** (2015) | A period horror that slowly unravels a family's sanity. |
|10 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Found‑footage scares that keep you on edge. |

Feel free to pick one or two from each category for a balanced fright marathon!
